name: Softech Addons for Elementor
author: shravanchoudhary

sections.description:
Softech Addons for Elementor enhances the Elementor experience with a set of advanced widgets and UI utilities. Whether you’re building complex layouts using Loop Grid/Slider, Image Accordion, and more—this plugin makes it all possible.

Free Widgets:

  • Loop Grid Slider
  • Testimonial Slider
  • Before After Slider
  • Blob Shapes
  • Flip Card
  • Image Accordion
  • Number Box
  • Dual Color Heading
  • PDF Viewer
  • Stripe Checkout
  • Mega Menu

How to Use Elementor Template Kit In Our Widgets

You can use templates in the Loop Grid Slider widget and Testimonial widget. When a template layout is selected, the Edit Template button becomes available in the widget options. If you need to edit the template, click the button to quickly navigate to the template inside the Template Library.

Pro Version

Want more powerful widgets and premium templates?
Get Softech Addons for Elementor Pro for exclusive features and advanced design tools.

Pro Widgets:

  • Site Logo
  • Post Info
  • Post Comments
  • Call To Action
  • Image Shapes
  • Popup Widget
  • Progress Bars

Widgets short Description:

1. Loop Grid Slider

Loop Grid Slider – A powerful and free Elementor grid slider widget. This widget can be used to showcase posts, products, portfolios, testimonials, or any custom content in a continuous loop layout. Supports multiple styles including carousel mode, multi-column layouts, card-style grids, responsive controls, autoplay, navigation arrows, and pagination options. Perfect for blog posts, listings, or dynamic content presentations with smooth transitions and full design flexibility.

2. Testimonial Slider

Testimonial Slider – A clean Elementor widget for displaying customer reviews in a slider format. Ideal for showcasing client feedback, star ratings, user photos, and detailed testimonials. Comes with text styling, avatar customization, autoplay options, loop mode, and elegant transitions. A perfect solution for trust-building sections on business, agency, or service-based websites.

3. Before After Slider

Before After Slider – An interactive Elementor image comparison widget. Allows users to drag a handle to compare two images side by side. Great for displaying transformations, edits, renovations, medical results, beauty treatments, restoration work, and more. Includes vertical/horizontal modes, label options, smooth animations, overlay styling, and full responsiveness.

4. Blob Shapes

Blob Shapes – A creative Elementor widget that generates organic, fluid-shaped blobs for modern website designs. Can be used as decorative elements, background highlights, image masks, or graphic accents in hero sections. Supports random shape generation, color controls, gradient backgrounds, SVG output, and full styling options to match your brand theme.

5. Flip Card

Flip Card – An interactive Elementor widget where the card flips on hover or click to reveal additional content. Ideal for service listings, team profiles, features, pricing boxes, or promotional content. Includes front/back design controls, flip directions, 3D animations, icons, images, and full typography customization.

6. Image Accordion

Image Accordion – A modern Elementor accordion made entirely of images. Expands smoothly on hover or click, revealing titles, descriptions, and call-to-action buttons. Perfect for galleries, category showcases, portfolios, headers, and storytelling layouts. Supports vertical/horizontal layouts, overlay colors, image effects, and advanced animation controls.

7. Number Box

Number Box – A simple and stylish Elementor widget for highlighting key numbers such as statistics, achievements, milestones, and business metrics. Includes icons, headings, number animations, description text, and customizable box layouts. Great for about pages, company highlights, service sections, and infographic-style displays.

8. Dual Color Heading

Dual Color Heading – An advanced heading widget for Elementor that lets you highlight specific words in a different color. Useful for hero titles, section headings, and marketing content. Includes typography controls, alignment options, gradient text, text backgrounds, and responsive design settings to enhance visual emphasis.

9. PDF Viewer

PDF Viewer – A convenient Elementor widget that displays PDF files directly on your webpage. Perfect for documents, menus, brochures, reports, forms, catalogs, or manuals. Supports zoom controls, scroll view, thumbnail navigation, and responsive adjustments. Eliminates the need for third-party PDF plugins or external viewer windows.

10. Stripe Checkout

Stripe Checkout – A powerful Elementor widget for seamless payment processing and e-commerce integration. Enables you to embed Stripe payment forms directly on your website for selling products, services, or accepting donations. Includes customizable button styling, product selection, pricing options, secure payment handling, and automated transaction notifications. Supports many currency options for global transactions. Perfect for online stores, membership sites, service providers, and fundraising campaigns with full PCI compliance.

11. Mega Menu

Mega Menu – An advanced Elementor navigation widget for creating professional mega menus with multiple columns, rich content, and custom layouts. Ideal for large e-commerce sites, corporate websites, and complex navigation structures. Supports image integration, custom widgets, submenu hierarchies, hover effects, responsive mobile menus, search functionality, and advanced styling options. Enhances user experience with organized, visually appealing menu systems that improve site navigation.

Credits

This plugin bundles the Swiper library (https://swiperjs.com/) licensed under the MIT license.

Support

If you find this plugin useful, consider supporting us via Softechure.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/softech-addons-for-elementor directory, or install it through the WordPress plugin screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to Elementor Editor and explore the new widgets.
sections.faq:
If something isn’t addressed here, how can we connect with you?

You’re welcome to message us anytime using our Contact form.

Does this require Elementor Pro?

No. Most widgets work independently with the free version of Elementor. However, if you want to use the Mega Menu widget in your website header, Elementor Pro is required since that feature relies on Elementor’s theme builder functionality. All other widgets like Loop Grid Slider, Image Accordion, Testimonial Slider, Stripe Checkout, and more work seamlessly with the free Elementor version.

Where can I find the new widgets after installation?

Once activated, the new widgets (like Loop Grid slider, Testimonial Slider, Before After Slider, etc.) will appear in the Elementor Editor panel under a dedicated section called “Widgets”.

Will your plugin affect the performance of my site?

We run tests to ensure the speed of the site is not affected when you activate our Elementor addons. We provide a way for you to deactivate those Elementor modules that you do not require for your site to avoid loading them unnecessarily on the pages.

Does it work with any theme?

YES! It will work with any theme where Elementor works.

What if I update to Premium version?

Your existing Elementor elements & content will work with premium version. So you won’t lose your developed contents or any elementor elements.
